title: CARVE: Verified Expansion for Variable-Length Generation in Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.30922v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Masked diffusion language models predict tokens from a partially observed response canvas, enabling bidirectional conditioning and parallel token refinement. Yet standard masked-diffusion decoders use a rigid inference interface: the number of masked positions allocated to the answer is fixed before generation begins. Choosing this length is difficult. A short canvas can truncate reasoning or code, while a long canvas wastes computation and can perturb denoising. We introduce CARVE (Counterfactual-Aware Reveal with Verified Expansion), a training-free variable-length algorithm for masked diffusion LMs. Starting from a shorter canvas, CARVE can grow the response during decoding by inserting additional [MASK] positions. Rather than keeping every insertion, CARVE tests a candidate expanded canvas and asks a counterfactual question: would the model make similar predictions for the unresolved positions in the original canvas if the extra mask

translated_title: CARVE：扩散语言模型中变长生成的经验证扩展
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散语言模型从部分观测的响应画布中预测词元，从而实现双向条件控制和并行词元精炼。然而，标准的掩码扩散解码器使用僵化的推理接口：分配给答案的掩码位置数量在生成开始之前就被固定。选择这个长度十分困难：过短的画布可能截断推理过程或代码，而过长的画布会浪费计算资源并可能干扰去噪过程。我们提出了CARVE（基于反事实感知的验证扩展），这是一种面向掩码扩散语言模型的无需训练的变长生成算法。CARVE从较短的画布开始，可以在解码过程中通过插入额外的[MASK]位置来扩展响应内容。CARVE并非保留每一次插入，而是测试候选的扩展画布并提出一个反事实问题：如果额外的掩码位置存在，模型是否会对原始画布中未确定位置做出相似的预测……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了CARVE，一种无需训练的变长生成算法，使掩码扩散语言模型能够在解码过程中通过反事实验证动态插入掩码位置来扩展响应，解决了固定画布长度导致的推理截断和计算浪费问题。
en_tdlr: CARVE is a training-free variable-length generation algorithm for masked diffusion LMs that dynamically expands the response canvas during decoding by inserting mask positions with counterfactual verification, solving the truncation and computation waste caused by fixed canvas length.
